## Problem and resulting behavior

Describe the concrete API, protocol, or maintenance problem and the resulting public behavior.

## Validation

- [ ] Formatting, Clippy, tests, docs, and examples pass as applicable.
- [ ] Request/response fixtures cover new wire behavior.
- [ ] Public API and compatibility implications are documented.
- [ ] No credentials, private prompts, or unsanitized live responses are included.

## Compatibility notes

List schema discrepancies, live-service evidence, unsupported cases, and migration requirements. Write `none` when there are no material notes.
